heavy-blow.name: Mighty Swing
heavy-blow.text: A crushing hit, harder for every point of Valor you are holding.

execute.name: Finishing Flourish
execute.text: Spend 3 Valor: a big hit, far harder on a foe under a third of its HP.

shield-bash.name: Shield Bonk
shield-bash.text: A hit that breaks any wind-up it has gathered, and stuns a lesser foe.

shield-wall.name: Castle Stance
shield-wall.text: Spend 2 Valor: a barrier worth a share of your HP.

holy-strike.name: Holy Strike
holy-strike.text: A hit that heals you for part of the damage.

paladin-oath.name: Blessed Guard
paladin-oath.text: Each blow you Block heals you a little.

judgement.name: Judgement
judgement.text: A hit that weakens its blows and makes it take more damage.

last-light.name: Last Light
last-light.text: Spend 3 Valor: the next blow that would fell you leaves you standing instead. Once a fight.

reckless.name: Reckless Swing
reckless.text: A huge hit that costs you some of your own HP.

berserker-rage.name: Rage
berserker-rage.text: You deal more damage, and take more.

blood-price.name: Blood Price
blood-price.text: Lose some of your HP: gain 2 Valor at once, and your hits land much harder for a few rounds.

bloodbath.name: Bloodbath
bloodbath.text: A hit that grows with all the HP you have lost: the nearer the end, the harder.

shield-slam.name: Shield Slam
shield-slam.text: A hit that grows with your defense.

knight-oath.name: Armoured
knight-oath.text: A fifth more defense, and part of each blow goes back at whoever struck.

iron-retort.name: Iron Retort
iron-retort.text: Spend 2 Valor: for a few rounds, far more of each blow goes back.

bulwark.name: Unbreakable
bulwark.text: For a few rounds your Block stops almost everything.

arcane-bolt.name: Arcane Bolt
arcane-bolt.text: A bolt of magic, stronger the more mana you still hold.

overflow.name: Overflow
overflow.text: Spend all your Arcana: mana back for each point, and your next spell hits harder.

arcane-shield.name: Bubble Shield
arcane-shield.text: A shimmering bubble worth a share of your HP that soaks the next damage.

time-warp.name: Pocket Watch
time-warp.text: Spend 4 Arcana: stop the clock, the enemy loses its next turn, boss or not.

fireball.name: Firework
fireball.text: A burst of flame: a huge hit that leaves it burning.

detonate.name: Detonate
detonate.text: Set off the fire: all the burning it has left lands at once, and stronger.

meteor.name: Falling Star
meteor.text: Call down a star: it lands two rounds later for a huge hit, whatever you do meanwhile.

smite.name: Smite
smite.text: Holy light: a strong hit that heals you a little.

cleric-grace.name: Grace
cleric-grace.text: Your healing is stronger, your defense too, and healing past full becomes a barrier.

mend.name: Mend
mend.text: Heal a share of your HP, and clear poison and weakness.

judgement-day.name: Judgement Day
judgement-day.text: A blast of light that grows with all you have healed this fight.

frost-blade.name: Frost Blade
frost-blade.text: For a few rounds your attacks chill: harder, and its blows weaken.

spellsword-bond.name: Spell and Steel
spellsword-bond.text: Your plain attacks use your magic too, and you are as sturdy as a fighter.

storm-blade.name: Storm Blade
storm-blade.text: For a few rounds lightning jumps from your attacks: much harder, and a chance of a second strike.

arc-slash.name: Arc Slash
arc-slash.text: Three quick cuts, far harder while your blade is infused.

backstab.name: Sneak Jab
backstab.text: A hit that crits half the time.

eviscerate.name: Grand Finale
eviscerate.text: Spend all your Mischief: a hit that grows with every point.

shadowstep.name: Vanishing Act
shadowstep.text: Slip away: the enemy's next blows miss.

pickpocket.name: Sticky Fingers
pickpocket.text: A quick cut and a quicker hand: gold from the enemy's purse, once a fight.

shuriken.name: Shuriken
shuriken.text: Four quick stars, each one a chance to crit.

ninja-step.name: Light Feet
ninja-step.text: You strike first in every fight, and dodge more.

smoke-escape.name: Smoke Escape
smoke-escape.text: Gone in a puff: you always get away, even from a boss.

clone.name: Shadow Clone
clone.text: A copy of you joins in: for a few rounds every attack strikes again.

shadow-dance.name: Shadow Dance
shadow-dance.text: Drop your guard: take this round's blow in full, then almost nothing can touch you for two rounds.

shadow-pact.name: Opportunist
shadow-pact.text: After you dodge a blow, your next hit is a sure crit.

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.text: A hard hit from the dark; far harder while you dance in shadow.

assassinate.name: Assassinate
assassinate.text: Spend 3 Mischief: a sure crit, far harder on a foe under a third of its HP.

poison-coat.name: Poison Coating
poison-coat.text: Coat your blade: your next hits poison, and each one makes it worse.

alchemist-brew.name: Master Brewer
alchemist-brew.text: Poison hurts half as much again, and potions do too.

caustic-flask.name: Caustic Flask
caustic-flask.text: A thrown flask: it takes more damage for a few rounds.

bitter-end.name: Bitter End
bitter-end.text: All the poison in its veins lands at once, and stronger.

sure-shot.name: Sure Shot
sure-shot.text: Spend 2 Aim: an arrow that surely crits.

aimed-shot.name: Bullseye
aimed-shot.text: One careful arrow, far harder on a foe that is winding up.

mark.name: Painted Target
mark.text: Paint a target on the enemy: your next hits land harder.

quick-reflex.name: Quick Reflexes
quick-reflex.text: For a few rounds you shoot back far more often.

ranger-eye.name: Double Nock
ranger-eye.text: Whenever you shoot back, you shoot twice.

return-fire.name: Overwatch
return-fire.text: Spend 2 Aim: for a few rounds you shoot back every time it strikes, hit or miss.

hawk.name: Owl Friend
hawk.text: Spend 2 Aim: your owl strikes on its own at the end of every round for a while.

owl-swoop.name: Owl Swoop
owl-swoop.text: Spend 3 Aim: the owl dives, a big hit that ignores its defense.

great-owl.name: Great Owl
great-owl.text: Spend 3 Aim: the owl strikes twice every round, for longer.

trap.name: Tripwire
trap.text: Lay a tripwire: the enemy's next wind-up fails.

trapper-craft.name: Cruel Traps
trapper-craft.text: An enemy caught in your tripwire takes a hard hit.

snare.name: Pinning Shot
snare.text: A hit, and its next blows are much weaker.

spike-trap.name: Killing Ground
spike-trap.text: For a few rounds each blow it tries sets off spikes, and it takes more damage.

pal-devotion.name: Devotion
pal-devotion.text: Your healing is 6% stronger a rank.

pal-mercy.name: Mercy
pal-mercy.text: Each win heals 5% of your HP a rank.

pal-consecrate.name: Holy Ground
pal-consecrate.text: A hit that leaves you healing each round for a while.

pal-wrath.name: Righteous Wrath
pal-wrath.text: A weakened foe takes 6% more a rank.

pal-aura.name: Warm Aura
pal-aura.text: You heal 1% of your HP each round, a rank.

pal-avenger.name: Avenging Strike
pal-avenger.text: Spend 2 Valor: a heavy hit that heals you for much of it.

pal-faith.name: Shield of Faith
pal-faith.text: Start each fight with a barrier of 5% of your HP, a rank.

pal-exorcism.name: Exorcism
pal-exorcism.text: A blast of light that leaves the foe taking more damage.

pal-zeal.name: Zeal
pal-zeal.text: Above 80% HP you deal 5% more a rank.

pal-miracle.name: Miracle
pal-miracle.text: Once a fight: back to most of your HP, cured of everything.

ber-fury.name: Bloodlust
ber-fury.text: With a great weapon, your hits heal you 3% of the damage they deal, a rank.

ber-thirst.name: Blood Thirst
ber-thirst.text: Each win heals 4% of your HP a rank.

ber-savage.name: Savage Hits
ber-savage.text: Your crits hit 10% harder a rank.

ber-wounds.name: Open Wounds
ber-wounds.text: Under a third of your HP you deal 6% more a rank.

ber-keen.name: Second Wind
ber-keen.text: Once a fight, when a blow leaves you under a quarter of your HP, you get back 8% of it, a rank.

ber-frenzy.name: Frenzy
ber-frenzy.text: Lose some HP: your hits land far harder for a few rounds.

ber-drink.name: Drink Deep
ber-drink.text: A crit heals you 2% of your HP, a rank.

ber-rampage.name: Rampage
ber-rampage.text: Four huge swings, at a cost.

ber-iron.name: Iron Will
ber-iron.text: Under a third of your HP you take 7% less a rank.

ber-deathwish.name: Death Wish
ber-deathwish.text: Under a third of your HP: a quarter more damage dealt, 15% less taken.

kni-guard.name: Practised Guard
kni-guard.text: A Block stops 5% more a rank.

kni-spikes.name: Spiked Plate
kni-spikes.text: 5% more of each blow goes back, a rank.

kni-taunt.name: Taunting Shout
kni-taunt.text: The foe swings wild: its blows are weaker for a few rounds.

kni-resolve.name: Resolve
kni-resolve.text: Start each fight with a point of Valor, a rank.

kni-bastion.name: Bastion
kni-bastion.text: Start each fight with a barrier of 6% of your HP, a rank.

kni-charge.name: Shield Charge
kni-charge.text: A hit that grows with your defense and stuns a lesser foe.

kni-rampart.name: Rampart
kni-rampart.text: Spend 3 Valor: a great barrier, and far more of each blow goes back.

kni-riposte.name: Riposte
kni-riposte.text: A 5% chance a rank to strike back when hit.

kni-fortress.name: Living Fortress
kni-fortress.text: Once a fight: a huge barrier, and for a while your Block stops nearly all.

wiz-ember.name: Embers
wiz-ember.text: Your burns hurt 8% more a rank.

wiz-focus.name: Focus
wiz-focus.text: Your spells are 3% stronger a rank.

wiz-well.name: Deep Well
wiz-well.text: 5% more mana and 4% more HP a rank.

wiz-scorch.name: Scorch
wiz-scorch.text: A cheap, quick flame that sets it burning.

wiz-kindling.name: Kindling
wiz-kindling.text: A burning foe takes 6% more a rank.

wiz-clarity.name: Clarity
wiz-clarity.text: You regain 1% of your mana each round, a rank.

wiz-sear.name: Searing Crits
wiz-sear.text: Your crits hit 10% harder a rank.

wiz-firestorm.name: Firestorm
wiz-firestorm.text: A round to call it, then the sky falls.

wiz-heart.name: Heart of Flame
wiz-heart.text: Each win gives back 5% of your mana a rank.

wiz-phoenix.name: Phoenix
wiz-phoenix.text: Once a fight: a great blast, and the next blow that would fell you leaves you standing.

cle-prayer.name: Prayer
cle-prayer.text: Your healing is 6% stronger a rank.

cle-calm.name: Calm Mind
cle-calm.text: You regain 1% of your mana each round, a rank.

cle-halo.name: Halo
cle-halo.text: Start each fight with a barrier of 5% of your HP, a rank.

cle-renew.name: Renew
cle-renew.text: You heal a share of your HP each round for a while.

cle-radiance.name: Radiance
cle-radiance.text: Above 80% HP you deal 4% more a rank.

cle-lance.name: Lance of Light
cle-lance.text: A beam that heals you for part of it.

cle-rest.name: Blessed Rest
cle-rest.text: Each win heals 5% of your HP a rank.

cle-sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
cle-sanctuary.text: A great barrier, and cured of everything.

cle-zeal.name: Holy Zeal
cle-zeal.text: Your spells are 3% stronger a rank.

cle-ascend.name: Ascension
cle-ascend.text: Once a fight: healed of most wounds, and your hits land far harder for a while.

spl-thrust.name: Spell Thrust
spl-thrust.text: A clean thrust, charged with whatever the blade holds.

spl-flow.name: Flow
spl-flow.text: A crit gives back 2% of your mana, a rank.

spl-surge.name: Surge
spl-surge.text: Start each fight with a point of Arcana, a rank.

spl-tempest.name: Tempest Blade
spl-tempest.text: The blade holds the storm longer, and bites harder.

spl-hunger.name: Hungry Blade
spl-hunger.text: A crit heals you 2% of your HP, a rank.

spl-avatar.name: Avatar of War
spl-avatar.text: Once a fight: for a while, every hit lands far harder.

nin-first.name: First Blood
nin-first.text: In the first round you deal 10% more a rank.

nin-kunai.name: Kunai Storm
nin-kunai.text: Five thrown blades, each with its own chance to crit.

nin-calm.name: Still Water
nin-calm.text: A dodge heals you 2% of your HP, a rank.

nin-edge.name: Razor Edge
nin-edge.text: Your crits hit 10% harder a rank.

nin-vanish.name: Vanish
nin-vanish.text: The next two blows miss, and your next hit is a sure crit.

nin-lotus.name: Falling Lotus
nin-lotus.text: Seven strikes too fast to follow.

nin-feint.name: Feint
nin-feint.text: After a dodge your next hit is a sure crit.

nin-army.name: Army of One
nin-army.text: Once a fight: copies of you join in, and every attack strikes again and again.

sha-dark.name: Cruel Edge
sha-dark.text: Your crits hit 10% harder a rank.

sha-opening.name: From Behind
sha-opening.text: In the first round you deal 10% more a rank.

sha-cut.name: Crippling Cut
sha-cut.text: A hit that weakens its blows.

sha-streak.name: Patient Blade
sha-streak.text: Every hit adds 1% more to your growing crit chance, a rank.

sha-finish.name: Finisher
sha-finish.text: A foe under a third of its HP takes 8% more a rank.

sha-blind.name: Blinding Powder
sha-blind.text: The enemy loses its next turn, boss or not.

sha-feed.name: Feed on Fear
sha-feed.text: A crit heals you 2% of your HP, a rank.

sha-reaper.name: Reaper
sha-reaper.text: A hard cut, and a killing one on a foe under 40% of its HP.

alc-toxin.name: Stronger Toxin
alc-toxin.text: Your poison hurts 8% more a rank.

alc-flask.name: Better Flasks
alc-flask.text: Your flasks work 10% better a rank.

alc-fumes.name: Fumes
alc-fumes.text: A poisoned foe takes 5% more a rank.

alc-vitriol.name: Vitriol
alc-vitriol.text: A splash that eats on for rounds.

alc-mend.name: Slow Mend
alc-mend.text: You heal 1% of your HP each round, a rank.

alc-bomb.name: Fire Flask
alc-bomb.text: A burst of flame that leaves it burning.

alc-salve.name: Salve
alc-salve.text: Each win heals 5% of your HP a rank.

alc-plague.name: Plague Cloud
alc-plague.text: A choking cloud: long poison, and weaker blows.

alc-tonic.name: Tonic
alc-tonic.text: You regain 1% of your mana each round, a rank.

alc-philosopher.name: Philosopher's Draught
alc-philosopher.text: Once a fight: most of your wounds healed, and your hits land harder for a while.

ran-quick.name: Quick Nock
ran-quick.text: A 3% better chance a rank to shoot back.

ran-pin.name: Hobbling Shot
ran-pin.text: A shot that stuns a lesser foe.

ran-steady.name: Steady Return
ran-steady.text: Your shots back are 6% stronger a rank.

ran-lethal.name: Lethal Shots
ran-lethal.text: Your crits hit 10% harder a rank.

ran-snipe.name: Long Shot
ran-snipe.text: A round to aim, then a very hard shot.

ran-opening.name: Opening Shot
ran-opening.text: In the first round you deal 12% more a rank.

ran-master.name: Master Archer
ran-master.text: Once a fight: for a while you shoot back at nearly everything, and shoot harder.

bea-bond.name: Close Bond
bea-bond.text: Your owl hits 8% harder a rank.

bea-call.name: Call the Owl
bea-call.text: The owl comes for a long while, no Aim asked.

bea-mend.name: Preening
bea-mend.text: You heal 1% of your HP each round, a rank.

bea-stoop.name: Stoop
bea-stoop.text: The owl dives with your arrow: a very hard hit.

bea-fierce.name: Fierce Owl
bea-fierce.text: Your owl hits 8% harder a rank.

bea-flock.name: The Flock
bea-flock.text: Three strikes from the owl every round, for a while.

bea-care.name: Kindly Care
bea-care.text: Each win heals 5% of your HP a rank.

bea-king.name: King of the Air
bea-king.text: Once a fight: the greatest owl there is, hitting twice a round, for a long while.

tra-wire.name: Barbed Wire
tra-wire.text: A foe caught by a trap also takes 15% of your attack, a rank.

tra-barb.name: Barbs
tra-barb.text: A stunned foe takes 6% more a rank.

tra-pit.name: Pit
tra-pit.text: It falls in: stunned for two rounds, if it is a lesser foe.

tra-prepared.name: Prepared
tra-prepared.text: In the first round you deal 10% more a rank.

tra-cunning.name: Cunning
tra-cunning.text: Start each fight with a point of Aim, a rank.

tra-net.name: Weighted Net
tra-net.text: It loses its next turn and hits weaker after.

tra-venom.name: Venom on the Spikes
tra-venom.text: A poisoned foe takes 5% more a rank.

tra-mine.name: Fire Pot
tra-mine.text: A buried pot goes off: a hard blast that leaves it burning.

tra-patient.name: Patient
tra-patient.text: A 3% better chance a rank to shoot back.

tra-master.name: Master of Snares
tra-master.text: Once a fight: its next three wind-ups fail, and it loses its next turn.
